sources.origin: Grok-generated audio or recorded studio mix thereof; not a claimed live recording

concept_basis: label-derived descriptors plus reviewed contexts; not acoustic classification

prompt_records.prompt: Six-second photorealistic single continuous shot, fixed camera, physical cause and target visible. Capture close, detailed, realistic sound synchronized with the visible action, strong enough to suit a dramatic game effect without clipping. No music, speech, voice, chiptune, synthesizers, artificial cinematic risers, cartoon effects, montage, edits or captions. Do not impose three takes: perform one complete event, with a clean natural onset and decay, and leave quiet when the event finishes. One powerful real gust sweeps quickly across tall dry grasses and dust in an outdoor effects area, rises and naturally fades within roughly 0.583 seconds. Record the close air-pressure movement and natural gust, keeping steady fan motor, leaf rustle, speech and unrelated background below audibility. One fluid onset and fade, not three impacts.
